notes.title: Update to Version 1.5.9 on August 10, 2025
notes.notes:
1.Added 5 new straight swords, 5 new greatswords, and introduced a new weapon type: [Slender Sword], along with 4 corresponding weapons.

2.Added 11 new spears.

3.Added a new enemy type: Lava Warlock.

4.Added a new boss: Mutant Giant.

5.Added a new enemy type: Hellhound.

6.Added a new enemy type: Venomous Scorpion.

7.Added a new enemy type: Night Elf.

8.Players now receive a blessing that restores HP upon successfully triggering a parry.

9.Optimized the performance of existing weapons.

10.Implemented the Graphics Quality Settings feature.

notes.title: Update log
notes.notes:
April 14,2025: Updated the transmission transition animation and optimized the hit response when invulnerable.  Improved the UI display of health bars and focus values.  Reduced the health of the Stone Man and increased double resistance.  Enhanced weapon frame stability.  Reduced the attack range of the War Axe 1A and decreased health consumption.  Partially replaced BUFF icons.  Optimized in-game item drop behavior for easier pickup.  Added physical interaction to treasure chests to prevent getting stuck

April 6, 2025: Added two new monsters, skeleton soldiers and stone men.  Added multiple waves of small monsters in boss battles.  Adjusted the probability of appearance of high-level monsters, resource output, and weapon prices
